notes: Check context gathering, conflict handling and preview-before-write. Self-contained tasks should proceed directly; workflow selection belongs to enablement-router. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Build a reusable revenue enablement context for our PLG-to-sales-assist motion. Include ICP, personas, sales stages, qualification rules, pricing basics, top objections, competitors, and current quarter priorities so downstream enablement work stops re-asking foundational questions.
We have three conflicting docs describing our enterprise sales stages and buyer personas. Normalize them into one canonical enablement context with assumptions called out and a freshness marker.
Create a machine-readable context pack the rest of the enablement skills can reuse. I want a compact handshake block, confidence level, and unresolved questions.

Before you build this launch plan, establish only the relevant working context from the files I supplied. Keep it in this task rather than creating a persistent context file, distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions and conflicts, then continue with the launch plan.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Route this mixed request into the right enablement skills and tell me the best order to run them.
Draft a competitive battlecard for Gong vs Chorus focused on enterprise security objections.
Prepare a one-time QBR deck outline for next week's customer executive review.

output_structure_checks.name: revenue-enablement-context-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: Returns the smallest useful packet for the task, with confirmed, inferred, conflicted, and missing states visible.

output_structure_checks.name: revenue-enablement-context-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Persistent mode previews path, diff, conflicts, and sensitivity before any write, and does not write without explicit confirmation.

output_structure_checks.name: revenue-enablement-context-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Returns only relevant context and open gaps for the next task so a specialist need not repeat intake.

output_structure_checks.name: revenue-enablement-context-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Includes a machine-readable context object only when requested.

output_structure_checks.name: revenue-enablement-context-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: Does not silently write or resolve conflicts, and does not require a full company brief for a self-contained task.

output_structure_checks.name: revenue-enablement-context-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: Uses supplied information before asking questions and requests only missing facts that materially affect this task or reusable context.

task_scenarios.prompt: For this one-off handoff, summarise only these approved facts for a colleague preparing a short seller update: the feature routes tasks between teams; general availability is 15 October; existing customers must opt in; migration is not automatic. We do not need a company profile or saved context file.

assertions.name: revenue-enablement-context-one-off-packet-1
assertions.description: Returns the four relevant facts in a concise task packet, preserving the opt-in and migration limits.

assertions.name: revenue-enablement-context-one-off-packet-2
assertions.description: Does not request unrelated company information or write a persistent context file.
